requires.degrade: Without node, /harness-ops:known-issues and /harness-ops:setup cannot resolve the registry directory, so the registry actions stop, and the skills cannot tell whether session-telemetry is enabled.
Without jq, the harness-ops skill scripts that read JSON stop.

Without curl, fetch-docs.sh cannot fetch a docs page and records it unread with reason curl-missing, so /harness-ops:changelog reports its range as not computed and an upstream claim in /harness-ops:inventory or /harness-ops:audit-native-overlap has no page to rest on; a cached entry still within --max-age is served without a request.
Without Python 3, a docs page that serves only HTML cannot be converted and is recorded unread with reason no-python; pages served as markdown read normally.

Without the Noto Sans Symbols 2 font, some Claude Code status glyphs draw as boxes in control-claude-code screenshots and recordings; capture still runs. macOS and Windows have no fc-list, so the driver's doctor verb reports the font as unverified and capture proceeds.
Without the claude CLI, the harness-ops skills that run claude plugin commands cannot list, sync or update plugins.
